name: Der Leere
source: The third sage, Ladja's assistant. A rag doll created by Lucy. The creator of Lucas (puppet), it took her a long time and many mistakes to create the perfect version of Lucas. For a long time, she did not dare to go against Ladja, but at one point it still happened...
translation: The third sage, Ladja's assistant. A rag doll created by Lucy. The creator of Lucas (puppet), it took her a long time and many mistakes to create the perfect version of Lucas. For a long time, she did not dare to go against Ladja, but at one point it still happened...
